1. FiffParser::parseData reads the first_ifd offset and parses the embedded TIFF structure (line 49-58)
2. FiffParser::getDecoder calls TiffParser::makeDecoder which returns a DngDecoder (line 117-126)
3. main.cpp calls decoder->decodeRaw() (line 87)
4. DngDecoder::decodeRawInternal → decodeData (line 366)
5. DngDecoder::decodeData creates the raw image buffer with dim.x=1, dim.y=65312 (line 287)
6. RawImage::createData allocates buffer and poisonPadding poisons the padding after each line (line 95, 116)
7. DngDecoderSlices::decodeSlice calls LJpegDecompressor::decode (line 158)
8. LJpegDecompressor::decode → AbstractLJpegDecompressor::decode (line 46)
9. AbstractLJpegDecompressor::decode → parseSOS (line 51)
10. parseSOS → decodeScan (line 136)
11. decodeScan → decodeN<2> (line 60)
12. decodeN<2> copy_n(predNext, N_COMP=2, pred.data()) reads 4 bytes from previous line's data, crossing into poisoned padding (line 95)

Let me write the trace.
